title: Hemispherical shell with an 18° hole under alternating point loads
source: MacNeal and Harder, 'A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy', Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1 (1985) 3–20, Fig. 9 (p. 9), Table 5(b) (p. 11): 0.0940 (lower bound 0.0924 from their [7])
